## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting user-visible behavior. Link a related issue when available.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Note platform or integration checks you could not perform.

- [ ] `npm run check` passes, or I explained why it was not applicable.
- [ ] Behavior changes have meaningful regression coverage where needed.
- [ ] UI screenshots and test fixtures contain only synthetic data.
- [ ] No user data, credentials, caches, or generated builds are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and root context files are current.

## Screenshots or limitations

Include these only when they help review the change.
